history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A person stands with their back to the camera, wearing a white hooded sweatshirt with a cursive "hnb" design on the back, and dark grey slim-fit pants. They have light blue and white sneakers on. The person is standing on a concrete pathway next to a black metal fence. Behind the fence, there's a building with a stone facade and a tiled roof, partially covered by a dark metal awning. Lush green trees and foliage are visible in the background, with a large water cooler bottle and a dark bag placed near the fence on the right side of the frame. The lighting is natural, suggesting an overcast day, casting soft shadows. The overall mood is casual and urban, with a muted color palette dominated by whites, greys, blues, and greens.
